label: GB-dpa-2018 Section 120C

obligations.text:
Strategy
(1)
The Commission must prepare a strategy for carrying out the Commission's functions under the data protection legislation in accordance with the Commission's duties under—
(a)
sections 120A and 120B,
(b)
section 108 of the Deregulation Act 2015 (exercise of regulatory functions: economic growth), and
(c)
section 21 of the Legislative and Regulatory Reform Act 2006 (exercise of regulatory functions: principles).

(2)
The Commission must—
(a)
review the strategy from time to time, and
(b)
revise the strategy as appropriate.

(3)
The Commission must publish the strategy and any revised strategy.
